title: Brass Sheet Engraving Stencil Helper
problem: Brass sheet metal engravers spend long, tiring hours sketching matching flower stencil designs by hand before hammering.
idea: Printable, perfectly balanced flower stencils made in Canva, so artisans can trace them straight onto the metal. Use the calculator to space the petals evenly.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Petal spacing helper
widgets.intro: For a round flower, petals must be spaced evenly around the centre.
widgets.formula: if (typeof petals !== 'number' || typeof dia !== 'number') return null; if (petals < 3 || petals > 36 || dia <= 0) return null; var angle = 360 / petals; var r = dia / 2; var gap = 2 * Math.PI * r / petals; return {angle: angle, r: r, gap: gap, level: 'good'};
widgets.result:
Turn {angle}° for each new petal.
Radius (centre to tip): {r} cm
Petal tips are about {gap} cm apart along the edge.

widgets.heading: ✂️ Make a symmetric stencil with paper folding

items.title: Fold
items.text: Fold a square paper in half, then in half again, then once diagonally.
items.te: చతురస్ర కాగితాన్ని సగానికి, మళ్ళీ సగానికి, తర్వాత వికర్ణంగా మడవండి.

items.title: Draw
items.text: Draw half a petal on the folded edge.

items.title: Cut
items.text: Cut along the line carefully with scissors.

items.title: Open
items.text: Open it — you get an 8-petal flower that is the same on all sides!
items.te: తెరిస్తే అన్ని వైపులా ఒకేలా 8 రేకుల పువ్వు!

items.title: Scan & polish
items.text: Photograph it and clean it up in Canva to print many copies.
items.te: ఫోటో తీసి కాన్వాలో సరిచేసి ఎక్కువ కాపీలు ప్రింట్ చేయండి.

questions.q: A flower has 6 petals. How many degrees between each petal?

questions.why: A symmetric design looks the same on both sides of a line.

questions.q: Why trace a stencil instead of drawing free-hand?
options: Saves time and every design matches
questions.why: Stencils make every piece neat and save the artisan's time.

how: Ask a brass artisan which flower shapes and sizes they use most.
Ask Gemini for traditional floral motifs (lotus, jasmine, 8-petal flower) and how to draw them simply.
In Canva, add a circle, then a petal shape. Duplicate it and rotate each copy by the angle from the calculator.
Group the petals, add a centre circle and make the lines thick and dark for easy tracing.
Print stencils in the sizes the artisan needs, on thick paper.
Give them to the artisan and ask for feedback to make better versions.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student helping brass sheet artisans. Suggest 5 traditional Indian floral motifs (like lotus and 8-petal flowers) that are symmetric and easy to trace, and explain in simple steps how to draw each one using circles and rotated petals in Canva.
